newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton prices mixed, new crops expected.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton prices mixed, new crops expected.

text.p: Indian cotton prices were mixed on Friday with Gujarat varieties falling while Punjab types were unchanged, dealers said.
There were increasing Gujarat cotton stocks ahead of the new crop arrivals, one dealer said.
In spot deals Gujarat Kalyan (medium-staple) fell by 100 rupese to 13,200/13,400 rupees per candy (355.56 kg) while wagad cotton slumped by 700/800 rupees to 11,200/11,300.
Punjab was quiet but sentiment was subdued. Bengal-deshi spot delivery was quoted steady at 825/830 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while October delivery was quiet at 850/860 rupees.
